qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the chain sprocket to injection pump?
What screw type is used for the toothed belt pulley to injection pump?
How much torque should be applied to the chain tensioner?
What is the torque specification for the toothed belt pulley to injection pump?
Which component has the highest torque specification in the injection pump drive system?
qa_pairs.answer: The toothed belt pulley to injection pump at 50 Nm

qa_pairs.question: Which component has the lowest torque specification in section 13.52?
What screw type is used for the chain tensioner?
What section number covers the injection pump drive specifications?
How many components are listed under the injection pump drive section?
qa_pairs.answer: Three components: chain sprocket to injection pump, toothed belt pulley to injection pump, and chain tensioner
